thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Detected elevated 5xx rates and latency from eu-central-1 region. Symptoms: AWS NAT/egress errors + CloudWatch Logs ingestion throttling. Impact: Hosted API and Dedicated eu-central-1 pools. Pager notified.

oncall-ryan: Acked. Jumping in. Can someone post quick scope (routes / customers)?

sre-olivia: Seeing a fanout to STS/CW logs -> consistent connection resets from 52.* IPs. Host-level 502/504 spikes on frontend in eu-central-1. Dedicated pool nodes showing model svc 503 on connect.

eng-ming: Confirmed: KV cache p99 latency rising, prefix cache miss rate up ~3x. Requests piling at the edge -> backend worker queue growth.

incident-bot: INCIDENT created: INC-2026-4829956789. Severity: P1. Initial status: investigating. Pager duty: oncall-ryan -> 5m elapsed.

oncall-ryan: @sre-olivia please try regional fallback routing to eu-west-1 for non-PII tenants and mark affected routes for failover.

sre-olivia: Initiating smart routing policy: route policy eu-central-1 -> eu-west-1 fallback for model text-generation, embeddings read-only. Applying canary to 10% traffic.

infra-adele: Spotted a surge in NAT gateway errors at the AZ euc1-az2; raising AWS support ticket. Starting graceful drain of 2 Dedicated nodes to stop warmup fail loops.

support-anna: We have ~8 customer tickets reporting 5xx for API calls in EU. High priority flagged customers: two enterprise tenants experiencing timeouts. They're asking ETA.

product-jess: Need immediate customer-facing summary. Any ETA for mitigation and whether SLA is impacted?

oncall-ryan: Mitigation in progress: canary fallback applied, drain started. Early telemetry shows outbound error rate dropping for routed traffic. ETA for broader rollout 10-15m if stable.

eng-ming: Lowering batch sizes and disabling aggressive KV prefetch in eu-central-1 to reduce connection churn. Patching edge proxies to skip heavy log fanout.

incident-bot: UPDATE: Canary routing success: 10% shifted -> error rate for that cohort down 70%. Status: mitigation in progress.

sre-olivia: After canary looks good, increasing fallback to 50%. Will monitor tail latency and token-per-second throughput.

infra-adele: Node drains complete on two nodes; restarted worker processes on remaining hosts. Observed partial recovery but some 5xx remains on old AZ.

support-anna: Posting suggested canned reply to affected customers: "We're experiencing elevated errors in eu-central-1 due to a third-party network/egress issue. We're routing traffic to a healthy region; partial recovery is underway. We'll share updates and a post-incident summary." 

product-jess: Fine. Also prep impact note for billing/SLAs. Keep me posted if we need to issue credits.

incident-bot: UPDATE: AWS status: NAT gateway error rate acknowledged in eu-central-1, ticket #123456789. AWS working on egress.

oncall-ryan: Rolling out fallback to 100% for non-sensitive tenants to stop customer-facing errors. Sensitive/PII customers remain pinned — contacting customer success for manual outreach.

eng-ming: 100% fallback applied for non-PII. Observability: global 5xx rate for Hosted API reduced to baseline within 8 minutes for routed traffic. Dedicated pool still showing residual 5xx for pinned nodes.

sre-olivia: For Dedicated pinned nodes, plan: 1) migrate workloads to eu-west-1 Dedicated spare capacity (requires config pin update + warmup), or 2) enable client-side retries with jitter for 10m window. Which is faster?

oncall-ryan: Short term: enable client-side retries + jitter and reduce batch size. Long term: migrate critical Dedicated workloads. Start migrations for customers who've opted into cross-region failover.

support-anna: Noted. CS is contacting pinned customers about manual failover option.

incident-bot: STATUS CHANGE: mitigated (partial). Root cause: AWS NAT/egress instability causing downstream STS/CloudWatch fanout failures and connection resets. Impact: Hosted API + Dedicated pools in eu-central-1. Ongoing actions: verify all pinned Dedicated workloads, finish migrations where opted in, follow up with AWS.

product-jess: Requesting concise timeline and AffectedCustomers list for the external incident report. Also include mitigation steps and next steps.

sre-olivia: Will assemble timeline. Early notes: Detection -> canary fallback -> 100% fallback non-PII -> node drains/restarts -> residual Dedicated mitigation -> customer outreach.

infra-adele: AWS support indicates elevated egress errors will persist for 30-60m. We'll monitor and decide on full Dedicated migrations after AWS stabilizes.

oncall-ryan: Handoff to SRE shift lead @sre-olivia for postmortem and long-running remediation. I'll remain available. Thanks all. :handshake:

support-anna: Posting status update to support channel and updating tickets.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (mitigated): final status will be posted after postmortem. Link to ops-runbook: https://redwood.internal/ops/incidents/INC-2026-4829956789

product-jess: Thanks. Please make action item to add more robust Dedicated cross-region failover testing and add observability for NAT/egress error correlation.

sre-olivia: Added to backlog and assignment created. Will include in postmortem.

oncall-ryan: Closing thread from on-call perspective. Reopen if any regression.
